deadline.value: The department states no closing date; applicants may apply to a potential supervisor even if no position is advertised.

gre_subject.value: The department page does not mention the Physics GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Before acceptance, the candidate concludes a doctoral agreement with the supervising professor, then applies to the department.
supervisor.quote: Furthermore, they conclude a Doctoral Agreement with their supervising professors

funding.value: The department page does not say how doctoral researchers are funded.

entry_route.value: Doctoral candidates normally need a German master's-level degree or an equivalent foreign degree; highly qualified bachelor's holders can be admitted under special rules.
entry_route.quote: Graduation at a German university (diploma, Magister, master, or state examination) or an equivalent degree achieved at a university abroad

notes: Umbrella PhD for the whole department ('Doktor:in der Naturwissenschaften' for research in one of its research areas); the department's research list includes Theoretical Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics, Geophysics and Meteorology and Climate Physics. Structured programs on the page include KSETA, KSOP, KSQM and GRACE. KSOP has its own portal and says 'There are no enrollment and study fees for a doctoral student at the KIT'; no override was saved for it. Candidates must also register with KHYS and find a mentor from another institute.
